Accelerate Time to Capacity Agreement by driving rigorous sales execution, including effective Proofs of Concept (POCs), champion decks, partner alignment, and Snowflake Professional Services engagement. Drive sustained customer consumption of the Snowflake platform by partnering with Customer Advisory Services, Product Management, and C-level customer executives on strategic account plans and workload expansion. Build and expand an in-region partner ecosystem across Southern Europe, collaborating with Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs) and cloud ecosystem partners including AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, and BI/AI partners. Strong understanding of cloud data platforms, AI/ML, analytics, and consumption-based SaaS business models. Strategic mindset with strong operational rigor, accurate forecasting skills, and the ability to connect regional execution to broader EMEA business drivers. High-energy, proactive, and collaborative leadership style with a proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top sales talent. Fluency in English and proficiency in at least one major South EMEA language (French, Italian, or Spanish). Established executive network across enterprise customers and System Integrator partners in France, Italy, Spain, and Portugal. review_candidates.description: You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do. At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful. When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives. Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world. Job Description: The Manager, Backup Storage & Data Resilience provides specialized 2LOD oversight and challenge of backup strategy, storage resilience, data recoverability, cyber recovery readiness, and recovery testing evidence. The role evaluates whether critical systems, applications, and data can be restored reliably within tolerance windows under severe but plausible disruption scenarios, including ransomware or data corruption events. Reporting to the Director, Regulatory and Subsidiary Reporting, the Manager, Regulatory and Subsidiary Reporting will be part of the Retail Advice & Solutions Finance team and will be responsible for all aspects of financial reporting processes related to the mutual fund dealer Sun Life Financial Investment Services (Canada) Inc. (SLFISI), investment dealer Sun Life Canada Securities Inc. (SLCSI) and insurance distributor Sun Life Financial Distributors Inc. (SLFDI).This encompasses accounting and regulatory reporting for SLFISI and SLCSI in compliance with Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization (CIRO) rules. The large scale and scope of this role requires a high level of accounting knowledge, controls and processes, analytical insight, and operational efficiency. What will you do? Backup & Data Recoverability Challenge Review and challenge backup strategy, coverage, frequency, retention, storage architecture, immutable/air-gapped backup practices, and alignment to criticality and recovery objectives. Assess whether backup and recovery capabilities are risk-based, complete, tested, and aligned to critical operation tolerances and RTO/RPO requirements. Identify gaps in data resilience, backup coverage, cyber recovery readiness, restore success rates, and evidence quality. Review backup and recoverability capabilities for cloud, hybrid, SaaS, and third-party technology services supporting critical operations. Challenge recovery dependencies, concentration risks, and recovery assumptions that may affect data restoration. Assess resilience and currency of backup platforms, recovery tooling, and recovery access controls. Recoverability Testing & Evidence Validation Challenge the scope, frequency, and adequacy of backup recovery testing, including critical applications, databases, infrastructure services, and cyber/ransomware recovery scenarios. Review evidence supporting restore capability, data integrity, recovery timing, test exceptions, failed restores, and remediation closure. Escalate material concerns where data recoverability is not demonstrated or where recovery assumptions are unsupported by evidence through established issue and governance processes. Risk Monitoring, Metrics & Reporting Contribute to KRIs and risk appetite measures related to backup coverage, restore performance, recoverability testing, cyber recovery readiness, data integrity, and unresolved gaps. Provide insights for senior governance reporting on backup/data resilience posture, trends, root causes, and remediation progress. Maintain challenge records, issue linkages, and evidence documentation suitable for audit, regulatory, and management review. Identify recurring recoverability issues, emerging risks, and dependency concerns affecting backup, data resilience, and cyber recovery capabilities requiring leadership & stakeholder attention. Partnership & Improvement Partner with DBTS, Cyber, Technology Resilience, Operational Resilience, BCM, TPRM, and Business Group stakeholders to ensure backup/data resilience is integrated into end-to-end resilience outcomes. Using validations and evidence review, continually look for & recommend practical improvements to recovery strategy, evidence standards, testing playbooks, prioritization criteria, and issue closure expectations. Support technology resilience reviews for major changes, cloud transformation, or new platforms where backup/data recoverability could affect critical operations. Observe integrated recovery exercises to assess the effectiveness of end-to-end data recoverability outcomes. Expected Outcomes / Measures of Success Evidence of independently validated recoverability of critical systems, applications, and data. Backup and cyber recovery capabilities are tested and reviewed on a risk-based basis and linked to business tolerances. Observed material gaps in backup coverage, restore success, data integrity, or cyber recovery readiness are formally captured and escalated. Management reporting provides meaningful visibility into recoverability risk and remediation progress. What do you need to succeed? Experience with backup and storage architecture, data recoverability, restore testing, immutable and air-gapped backups, cyber recovery, ransomware scenarios, database/application recovery, and technology risk. Understanding of operational resilience, BCM/DR lifecycle, E-21, B-13, risk appetite, KRIs, issue management, and independent 2LOD challenge expectations. Ability to review technical evidence, identify recoverability gaps, and translate technical weaknesses into resilience risk and remediation needs. Strong analytical, documentation, stakeholder management, and constructive challenge skills. University degree or equivalent combination of education and experience. Typically 7+ years of experience in backup/storage, technology recovery, cyber recovery, technology risk, operational resilience, disaster recovery, or related fields. Professional certifications or training in cloud resilience, storage/backup platforms, cyber recovery, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, CBCP/MBCI, ITIL, DRI/BCI, or equivalent are assets. What’s in it for you? We’re proud to be recognized as a company with a 2026 Most Trusted Executive team by Great Place to Work® Canada Access to short-term assignments or ‘Gigs’ across the organization, to help you develop new skills and connections. A collaborative and interactive team environment Charitable giving through our You Give, We Give program lets you give back to your community – and in many cases, we’ll match your contributions. Care Days available for self-care or care of others (i.e., family or others you may support) and Sick Days to support your well-being. The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results. Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds. Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com. We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you. We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling. We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted. Salary Range: 85,000/85 000 - 128,000/128 000 Job Category: Risk Management Posting End Date: 05/12/2026
